st: You Sold Me A Sick Puppy!
d: After Billie's puppy died 6 days after purchase, she demands the seller reimburse her for vet bills, pain and suffering.
Trudy is suing bar owner Jefferey for damages because she claims a drunk patron plowed into her parked car.
Andrew is accusing his ex boss of assault and demands retribution for his back pain after the attack.
Mirtha is suing her ex-husband for stealing her car and leaving her to pay the bills after he up and left.

st: You Had A Wife, A Fiance, And A Mistress?
d: Arthur is suing his ex-fiancé for the price of her engagement ring after she refused to return it.
Joan is taking Sena to court after she gave away 5 cats she asked Sena to care for after Hurricane Sandy.
Andrew is suing Rachel after buying a lemon car due to her distracting him by dressing provocatively.
Sherri is suing her ex-husband for her son's unpaid medical bill and emotional distress.
Liatwanne petitions the court for rehab for her son, saying he's an addict who started using drugs as a teen.

st: You Are The Worst Landlord Ever!
d: Daniyal is suing her landlord for shutting off her electricity, cutting the gas, and evicting her without notice.
Amanda is suing her nail tech Jonyell after paying for her to take a nail class but she breached their contract.
Nicole is suing the man she rented a room from after making her uncomfortable and changing the locks after a fight.
James has not paid Carlita for restoring an antique stove because he feels he was coerced into the repairs.
Tyrone claims his ex wife Tania got him falsely arrested 3 times so he's here to sue her for $3,000.
Miguel is suing his friend of 30 years because he believes the defendant is the cause of his dog's death.
Lynn believes his wife was cheating on him throughout their relationship, now he's here to be paid back for a loan.
David is suing John after he was unable to get the car registered because he claims the title wasn't notarized.
